backup.production_rule: One new read-only function (prior_receipt_use_v1) and two new indexes on payment_evidence_candidates, which has 0 rows today so both indexes build instantly. No existing column, row, function, policy or grant is changed. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: function_exists
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'prior_receipt_use_v1'

forward_verification.name: function_is_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path='] from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'prior_receipt_use_v1'

forward_verification.name: execute_is_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.prior_receipt_use_v1(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.prior_receipt_use_v1(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.prior_receipt_use_v1(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')

forward_verification.name: both_property_scoped_indexes_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'payment_evidence_candidates' and indexname in ('payment_evidence_property_hash_idx', 'payment_evidence_property_reference_idx')

rollback.safe_until: always (drops one read-only function and two indexes; no evidence row is read or written by the rollback)

steps.name: redeploy_previous_upload_booking_receipt
steps.action: deploy upload-booking-receipt from waves 95d164e so it stops calling prior_receipt_use_v1

feature_flags.name: receipt_card_shows_prior_use
feature_flags.required_state: The SPEC-10 upload-booking-receipt build is deployed only AFTER this release is applied. Deployed earlier, its prior_receipt_use_v1 call errors, the error is caught and logged as '[upload-booking-receipt] prior use', and the card is still sent without the duplicate group. The new Do line and the overpayment group do not depend on this release at all.

compatibility.evidence: A new function and two new indexes; nothing before this release names either. The join semantics were proven read-only on production 2026-09-20 with a CTE carrying the same five-candidate fixture: probing the resent image returns exactly one row on the other booking labelled 'image', probing the shared reference returns one labelled 'reference', a null reference returns none, and a candidate never reports its own booking or another property's. pgTAP supabase/tests/database/prior_receipt_use.sql, 10 assertions, fixtures created and rolled back inside the test transaction; CI runs it on push (no local Docker).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty
